item.title: Mines Ministry launches ninth round of auctions, offers 20 critical mineral blocks
item.description: Till date, across the eight tranches of mineral block auctions, 100 unique critical and strategic mineral blocks have been offered, of which 64 blocks have been successfully auctioned.

item.title: NPCI says MDR charge has been imposed to save the UPI ecosystem from turning ouroboric
item.description: Zero MDR is no longer sustainable; the magnitude of growth places correspondingly greater demands on the security, resilience, and infrastructural capacity of the system, NCPI tells SC

item.title: CBG blending at 1.7% in H1; pipeline connectivity key to achieving 3% target
item.description: India has a target of blending 3% CBG into D-PNG and CNG by the end of current fiscal, 4% in 2027-28 and 5% in the subsequent year.

item.title: ONGC Q2 net profit jumps 57% on higher crude, gas realisations
item.description: Along with the results, the company declared an interim dividend of ₹8 per equity share.

item.title: From poverty alleviation to prosperity
item.description: India has reduced extreme poverty, but its high prosperity gap shows that millions remain far from a comfortable standard of living; informal work, stagnant wages and limited employment opportunities continue to constrain upward mobility

item.title: U.S. midterm elections: An economy under pressure, political shift and the road ahead
item.description: Despite robust economic growth, a buoyant stock market and relatively low unemployment, rising living costs have emerged as a major political challenge for the Trump administration

item.title: Oil prices hit two-month low after U.S. Democratic win
item.description: Brent crude futures dropped 1% to $93.5 per ⁠barrel, after an 8.7% slide in the previous session

item.title: Centre earmarks ₹2,814 crore to boost lithium, nickel processing
item.description: In a social media post, Union Coal and Mines Minister G. Kishan Reddy stated the scheme would help strengthen domestic capabilities, boost manufacturing and reduce dependence on imports.

item.title: Union Cabinet approves new VISTAR scheme to overhaul India’s statistical system
item.description: The three-pronged scheme is aimed at strengthening data collecting, analysis, the incorporation of AI, as well as provide fresh data on the unorganised sector to make the overall GDP figure more accurate

item.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme to develop large scale energy storage in India
item.description: The scheme is designed to provide for the development of hydro pumped storage plant (PSP) capacity, battery energy storage system (BESS) capacity, as well as alternative energy storage technologies

item.title: U.S. midterm elections impact on India: Faster trade deal talks and higher tariffs likely
item.description: Trade and geopolitical experts say that losing control of the U.S. Congress will push President Donald Trump to increase tariff pressure on India to seal a deal. Indian negotiators, for their part, will smell an opportunity

item.title: Supreme Court upholds States’ power to levy additional sales tax, says case has become academic
item.description: The seven-judge Bench, led by CJI Surya Kant, said the reference in the Orissa Sales Tax Act case no longer requires adjudication since the challenged provisions have been amended and GST governs the issue moving forward

item.title: Services sector activity hits 4-month high in October as business conditions improve cautiously
item.description: Survey participants identified new business growth as the main driver behind the rise in output, the survey said

item.title: Union Cabinet to discuss capex support for critical mineral processing, VGF for RE grid-scale storage system
item.description: The Hindu had learnt previously that the potential scheme could provide support of about 30% for setting up of these processing plants

item.title: Oil rises on Iran war uncertainty after Trump’s Republicans face election rout
item.description: In the previous session, Brent settled at its lowest level in nearly four weeks ‌as traders weighed talks to end the wars in Ukraine and Iran

item.title: NMDC’s iron ore output rose 18% in Oct, sales dip amid rain impact
item.description: Dispatches were temporarily impacted by disruptions to the Kottavalasa–Kirandul (KK) railway line after sections of the route were washed away due to heavy monsoon rains in September and October.

item.description: MSC​​ARO and ICAI build guardrails for multi-state cooperatives aspiring to become banks

item.description: Along with their results, Petronet LNG also declared a dividend of ₹7 per equity share

item.title: Congress seeks JPC probe into IDBI Bank sale, alleges valuation irregularities
item.description: The party questions the use of bank’s funds by Fairfax to finance acquisition; demands disclosure of valuation reports

item.title: Capex push to continue, but fiscal prudence non-negotiable: FM
item.description: “India must to talk with optimism and there needs to be reduction in cynicism says Ms. Sitaraman

item.title: No-cost EMI: a loan that is portrayed as free
item.description: A ₹60,000 phone, 6 easy instalments of ₹10,000, no interest. It feels as if the shopkeeper has done you a favour. He has not. Nobody lends money for free and nobody sells at a loss. Someone pays.

item.title: Coal India’s production increases 19% as mining recovers after monsoon slump
item.description: In a statement, the Coal India said, “The achievement assumes greater significance in view of the need to augment coal stocks at thermal power plants amid rising power demand.”

item.title: GST mop-up surges 23% to second-highest level of ₹2.31 lakh crore in October on festive demand boost
item.description: Gross GST collections from domestic sales rose 16% to over ₹1.59 lakh crore, and revenues from imports climbed 42% to ₹72,246 crore

item.title: India’s coal imports decline 5.83% in August
item.description: According to a statement from the Coal Ministry, the decline was primarily led by the power sector whose imports during the reported period declined 6.4% overall.

item.title: Petrol export duty cut to nil, diesel levy raised by ₹3 a litre
item.description: The government’s fortnightly review raised the export levy on diesel to ₹11.5 per litre from ₹8.5 and on aviation turbine fuel to ₹11 per litre from ₹10.5, while India’s diesel exports touched 700 kilo barrels per day in October, the highest since September 2025, according to Kpler

item.title: Playbook to overcome inflation
item.description: Fuel, education, healthcare, and travel costs tend to surge in urban and semi urban areas and hence inflation can differ depending on what you consume

item.title: IOC says crude Q2 price volatile as procurement swings between discounts and premiums
item.description: Anuj Jain, Director (Finance) at Indian Oil also stated under-recoveries on LPG is projected at ₹309/cylinder in November and ₹370/cylinder in December.

item.title: Towards recognising women farmers
item.description: Maharashtra’s passage of the Women Farmers’ Empowerment Bill, granting women independent recognition as farmers irrespective of land ownership, brings into focus the structural bias against the female agricultural workforce, highlights the need for a database of women farmers and using it to ensure access to welfare schemes

item.title: Disinvestment as key economic strategy
item.description: Given the fact that privatisation of several PSEs is a long journey, calibrated disinvestment could serve as an interim measure

item.title: Coal India profit jumps 57% as higher offtake, prices weigh over costs
item.description: Cost of input materials increased 20% during the quarter.

item.title: Deepavali sales expected to gain momentum in Coimbatore next week
item.description: With Deepavali falling in the first week of a month this year, people are likely to begin shopping after receiving their monthly salaries and festival bonuses; the last 5-6 days preceding the festival is likely to witness massive retail activity

item.title: U.S. Fed holds rates steady; pressure on emerging markets expected with stronger dollar outlook
item.description: The U.S. Fed is expected to keep the rates elevated, making U.S. Treasuries and the dollar relatively more attractive than emerging market economies for foreign investors

item.title: U.S. Fed holds interest rates steady despite surging inflation
item.description: The 12-member FOMC voted 10-2 to hold rates at a target range between 3.75 and 4.00%, citing the need for more data in the fight against inflation

item.title: How neoliberalism turned the world against its young
item.description: The rise in youth unrest stems from failures of neoliberal capitalism, which has weakened public welfare and worsened unemployment; as falling wages undermine consumption and investment, young people face fewer jobs, rising education costs and an economic system that prioritises profits

item.title: Vedanta Group eyeing $20 billion profits over next two years: Chairman Anil Agarwal
item.description: Vedanta is targeting $11 billion in profits this year, Chairman Anil Agarwal said.

item.title: The way out of the dangerous trap
item.description: India risks a middle-income, low-productivity trap as weak job creation, stagnant wages and sluggish investment reinforce one another; escaping it requires better vocational education, wider diffusion of technology and useful knowledge, and greater social value for skilled work

item.title: The gap in manufacturing sector GVA
item.description: According to the National Accounts Statistics, the manufacturing sector’s GVA is ₹38.6 lakh crore in 2023-24 at current prices.; however, an ‘Alternative Estimate’ using data from the Annual Survey of Industries and Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises gives a lower figure, prompting a closer look at the official estimate

item.title: India and Mexico sign Terms of Reference for preferential trade agreement negotiations to begin
item.description: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal visited Mexico for the signing. The two sides also discussed a possible business delegation from Mexico visiting India in the first quarter of 2027

item.title: On the question of KIIFB’s future
item.description: An expert panel constituted by Keralam’s UDF government to review the functioning of KIIFB has recommended winding it up and absorbing its functions into the State government, prompting a closer look at the merits of off-budget borrowings by States and the need to boost public investment in Keralam

item.title: What the new E100 vehicle rules mean | Explained
item.description: The amendments modify Rule 115, which deals with emission standards and related requirements for motor vehicles, and Rule 115E, which contains additional provisions relating to emission testing

item.title: Coal India H1 capital expenditure surges 27% to ₹7,966-cr, exceeds target
item.description: The capex spend in the first half of the fiscal year surpassing the stipulated target of ₹7,286 crore for the period.

item.title: Nayara Energy hikes petrol by ₹5, diesel by ₹3
item.description: Nayara, which operates 7,108 petrol pumps across the country, raised petrol and diesel prices with effect from early hours of Saturday, October 3, sources said

item.title: India poised to refine for world as global capacity declines: Union Minister Hardeep Puri
item.description: India's refining capacity is currently around 290 million tonnes per annum and is expected to expand further, he said

item.title: IndusInd Bank posts profit of ₹1,242 crores in Q2; asset quality improvement and interest income drives growth
item.description: The bank’s bottom line for Q2FY27 was supported by a rise in net interest income, which stood at ₹4,569 crore as against ₹4,409 crores a year ago

item.title: BPCL shifts crude sourcing towards Middle East as Russian oil loses price edge
item.description: Russian crude accounted for 37% of their import basket in the second quarter.

item.title: UPI and the cost of policy reversal
item.description: The government’s proposal to allow an MDR of 0.25–0.5% on UPI transactions above ₹2,000 reverses a decade-long policy; taxing the payment rail could weaken incentives for banks and fintechs to invest in UPI while undermining its role in financial inclusion, formalisation and wider digital adoption

item.title: How India’s life insurance sector funds government expenditure
item.description: A significant share of life insurance premiums is reinvested in securities that finance government expenditure. While the case for deeper insurance penetration is often made in terms of household financial protection, it is equally important for sovereign fiscal stability

item.title: Swiping in dark: The hidden cost of plastic money
item.description: It’s easy to swipe a card to satisfy a desire and gratify an impulse. However, unmindful swipe scan accumulate into a mountain of debt, take a toll on monthly budget, and derail financial goals

item.title: Ethanol tender sparks feedstock concerns as rice gains ground over maize
item.description: The competing concerns highlight the challenge facing the ethanol procurement framework: balancing the availability and cost of different feedstocks.

item.title: Data suggests broad-based increase in food prices: RBI Bulletin
item.description: Inflation in rural areas was found to be higher than in urban areas; headline CPI inflation edged up over the months and showed signs of greater generalisation across commodities

item.title: Bharat Petroleum’s net profit dips amid volatile crude prices in Q2
item.description: Bharat Petroleum’s revenues spurred 29% whilst net profit declined 22.5% on a year-over-year basis in Q2

item.title: Government to modify labour survey to capture gig economy, unpaid household workers
item.description: Periodic Labour Force Survey will include additional questions to measure labour underutilisation

item.title: Crude oil sourcing presently volatile; procuring more on landed basis: HPCL Chief
item.description: Vikas Kaushal, Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) informed the state-owned OMC is procuring more on landed basis than on FOB basis and term contracts

item.title: Net FDI at $3.3 billion in September 2026, positive for third consecutive month
item.description: FDI inflows exceeded outflows in seven out of the last eight months, a reversal of what occurred in the five months before that

item.title: Oil prices extend rally to near six-month high amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: Brent crude futures touched an intraday high of $114.94 a barrel on Friday after Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian and energy infrastructure, with India’s crude basket averaging $120.08 so far this month; Adani Total Gas raised CNG prices by ₹4.45 per kg

item.title: India-Poland strategic partnership should translate into JVs: PM Donald Tusk
item.description: Poland PM Donald Tusk called for greater technological cooperation between India and Poland, while addressing the India-Poland Business Forum at Bengaluru

item.title: Economics beyond the individual
item.description: Mainstream macroeconomics’ focus on individual choices overlooks how business investment, driven by profit expectations and uncertainty, shapes economic growth and instability; Keynesian economics shows why saving does not guarantee investment and why economic structure matters

item.title: Why managing fiscal is a tightrope for State governments
item.description: Most State government expenditure is on social sectors, such as health and education, and economic sectors, such as agriculture and irrigation. In Kerala, such spending has driven social progress since the 1960s. The gap between expenditure and receipts is usually financed through market borrowings.

item.title: The RBI and its growing fiscal role
item.description: RBI’s record ₹2.87 lakh crore surplus transfer to the Centre shows its growing fiscal significance, as earnings from reserve management and foreign assets support govt. finances; the trend raises questions about central bank independence, fiscal centralisation, and exclusion of such transfers from fiscal devolution to States

item.title: The reality behind falling net FDI
item.description: India’s net FDI has declined sharply despite strong gross inflows, underlining the impact of disinvestment/capital repatriation; an understanding of these trends requires looking beyond aggregate inflow, outflow figures; investor classes, modes of entry, and exit strategies can have important implications for technology transfer, industrial development, and external sustainability
